description: Rental Passive Loss Allowance (IRC 469) — How much of a rental real estate loss you can deduct this year under the passive activity rules (Form 8582). Required: rental_loss (USD), magi (USD). Optional: filing (single|mfj|hoh|qss|mfs_apart|mfs_together), carryforward (prior suspended losses), passive_income (other passive income), active (true|false, default true), re_professional (true = real estate professional, losses nonpassive), disposed (true = entire interest sold, losses released). Applies the $25,000 special allowance phased out by 50% of MAGI over $100,000 ($12,500/$50,000 MFS apart, $0 MFS together). Returns allowed loss, suspended carryforward, verdict. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_passive_loss
